The checkpoint directory has advanced to **808 completed roots**: root 1157 finished in the immediately preceding run, with 14,161,193 nodes. I’ll use 808 as this reply’s starting count and continue with root 1156, retaining per-second-array checkpoints so partial runs are reusable.

The order-13 exact search continued using five OpenMP threads. **Thirteen additional canonical roots were exhaustively eliminated**, with all completed second-array branches preserved in local `.done` checkpoints.

The completed roots this reply were: 1156, 1155, 1154, 1153, 1152, 1148, 1147, 1146, 1144, 1143, 1141, 1138, and 1137.

No GitHub operations were performed. The checkpoint directory is preserved for the next continuation.

One chunk on root 1155 was terminated before writing its summary. Its completed checkpoint nodes are counted, but interrupted subbranch nodes cannot be recovered. Consequently, the node and runtime figures below are conservative lower bounds.
